text.arabic_uthmani: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًۭا مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ ۖ فَمَن تَبِعَنِى فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّى ۖ وَمَنْ عَصَانِى فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌۭ رَّحِيمٌۭ

words.gloss_range: direct possessed Lord-address opening the complaint; the local form is vocative, with lordship felt as authority, ownership, and sustaining care
words.root_gloss_range: lordship, mastery, ownership, maintenance, and nurturing care; the local vocative selects possessed divine address
words.prose: {{ar:رَبِّ}} ({{tr:rabbi}}) opens the ayah as direct prayer, not detached analysis. The deleted first-person possessive makes the address intimate, while the root's lordship and nurturing range means the complaint about idol damage is placed before the one who governs and sustains. The repeated prayer address carries the petition across 14:35, 14:36, and 14:37, so the conditionals that follow remain inside one sustained appeal. The nominative variant shows how the same opening could tilt toward predication, while the contrast with deferred following (14:44) stays secondary to the local vocative frame.

topics.headline: possessed vocative makes intimate address
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Ibrāhīm begins with a direct possessed address, so the complaint is spoken as a plea to my Lord rather than as a neutral report.
topics.reason: QAC identifies a vocative construct with the first-person possessive yāʾ deleted but preserved by kasra.

topics.headline: lordship and nurture converge
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the address brings authority and sustaining care together before the ayah names how idols damaged human direction.
topics.reason: The root range supports ownership, mastery, and nurturing pressure, while the local noun remains a divine vocative title rather than an active verb of rearing.

topics.headline: repeated prayer address frames the ayah
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the whole ayah remains a prayer-analysis addressed to God, continuing the nearby petition register.
topics.reason: The same-surah prayer register includes the adjacent openings in 14:35, 14:36, 14:37, 14:40, and 14:41, and the local clause is syntactically framed after the vocative.

topics.headline: variant and boundary evidence sharpen the frame
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the local vocative is one member of a wider prayer boundary, while variant and cross-ayah contrasts remain secondary evidence rather than the governing parse.
topics.reason: The canonical local form is vocative; the reported nominative variant is useful as contrast, and the following contrast with deferred following (14:44) does not replace the local prayer address.

words.gloss_range: emphatic assertion particle with feminine plural pronoun, resuming the idols from the prior ayah as the stated subject of misguidance
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّهُنَّ}} ({{tr:innahunna}}) pulls the previously named idols across the ayah boundary and makes them the asserted topic before the verb arrives. The fused particle and feminine plural suffix mean reference and emphasis land together: the complaint is not tentative, and the idols are not left as a vague background cause.

topics.headline: feminine plural pronoun resumes the idols
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the ayah depends on the previous idol reference and carries that feminine plural agency into the new sentence.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the suffix antecedent as the idols from the previous ayah, and the following verb preserves feminine plural agreement.

topics.headline: assertion particle packages idol agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that idol misguidance is presented as asserted fact inside the prayer, not as a speculative explanation.
topics.reason: The particle governs a noun clause whose predicate is the misguidance verb, creating an emphatic complaint clause.

topics.headline: pronoun fronting highlights the agent
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the idols before their action, so their agency is foregrounded rather than discovered after the verb.
topics.reason: The pronoun is the ism of the assertion particle before the verbal predicate, making the referent prominent.

words.gloss_range: completed causative misguidance by the feminine plural idol subject; path-loss pressure is active through the selected Form IV verb
words.root_gloss_range: losing the way, error, distance from guidance, and perishing; the local Form IV selects causing others to lose the path
words.prose: {{ar:أَضْلَلْنَ}} ({{tr:aḍlalna}}) gives the idols full feminine-plural verbal agency and reports the damage as completed before the response conditionals begin. Form IV turns path loss into caused misguidance: the people are not simply described as lost, but as made to lose direction. The surah-local field of misguidance, including 14:18 and 14:30, keeps the verb inside a larger pattern of distance from right direction.

topics.headline: feminine plural ending grants idol agency
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that inanimate idols receive full grammatical agency in the complaint.
topics.reason: The verb is third feminine plural and agrees with the feminine plural idol pronoun.

topics.headline: perfect verb reports completed damage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Ibrāhīm speaks from damage already done, which explains the move from protection petition to response classification.
topics.reason: The perfect verb follows the protection request in 14:35 and precedes the conditional sorting in 14:36.

topics.headline: Form IV causes path loss
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the verb makes idolatry a directional displacement caused by idols, not only a moral label.
topics.reason: The root's path-loss range survives as image pressure, while Form IV and the direct object frame select caused misguidance.

topics.headline: misguidance joins the surah's guidance field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that following Ibrāhīm becomes the local alternative route after idol-caused misguidance.
topics.reason: The same root participates in the surah's straying field, with explicit same-surah links such as 14:18, 14:27, and 14:30.

words.gloss_range: large but unenumerated affected scale, locally resolved by the following partitive phrase as many people rather than total humanity
words.root_gloss_range: abundance, multiplicity, being or making many, and excess; the local adjective selects non-numeric largeness
words.prose: {{ar:كَثِيرًۭا}} ({{tr:kathīran}}) registers scale before the population is named. Its accusative position can point toward object or extent, but the following partitive phrase resolves the local effect toward a large human subset. The tanwīn keeps the number open: the damage is massive without becoming total. The abundance family names the affected scale here, not an act of multiplying the people themselves.

topics.headline: accusative allows object or extent pressure
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the word carries both object-scale and extent pressure before the following phrase narrows it to a human subset.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence treats it as object of the misguidance verb, while the local accusative also allows extent pressure in the row's claim.

topics.headline: tanwīn leaves many uncounted
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the affected group is large but deliberately uncounted, leaving room for the follower class that comes next.
topics.reason: The adjective is indefinite with tanwīn and is followed by a partitive population phrase.

topics.headline: abundance becomes population-scale damage
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the family protection concern widens into a human-scale pattern of idol-caused misguidance.
topics.reason: The word precedes and is specified by the phrase for people, making scale the bridge from personal petition to public damage.

topics.headline: abundance without multiplying people
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices abundance as the scale of the damage, while the local adjective does not claim the idols multiply the people themselves.
topics.reason: The local form is a qualitative adjective of largeness, not a causative verb of making many.

words.gloss_range: partitive preposition specifying the many as drawn from humanity and limiting the scope of idol misguidance
words.prose: {{ar:مِنَ}} ({{tr:mina}}) turns abundance into a subset: many are taken from among humanity, not all humanity. The preposition therefore keeps the idol effect limited even while the preceding word makes the damage large, leaving space for the following class who follow Ibrāhīm.

topics.headline: partitive preposition limits the scope
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the idols misled many from humanity, not humanity without remainder.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence make the preposition govern the people phrase as the complement specifying the many.

topics.headline: source and explication pressure serve the partitive
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices both the source pool and the limiting force: the many are drawn from, and specified as, people.
topics.reason: The local attachment to the abundance word and people noun licenses source-pool and explicative pressure, with partitive scope as the governing function.

words.gloss_range: definite human collective governed by the partitive preposition, functioning as the source pool from which the many misled are drawn
words.root_gloss_range: human sociability, familiarity, perception, and disputed forgetting pressure; the local noun selects the collective people
words.prose: {{ar:ٱلنَّاسِ}} ({{tr:al-nāsi}}) names the affected pool as the recognizable human collective. Its genitive case under the partitive preposition makes humanity the source from which the many are drawn, not a second object. The disputed root pressure is useful but limited: sociability or forgetfulness helps explain why misguidance spreads through a human collective, while the local noun remains people. That collective field is public before the conditionals sort individual responses, and it continues into later warning and clarification scenes (14:44; 14:52).

topics.headline: definite genitive people form the source pool
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the many come from a definite human collective, not from an undefined crowd or a second object.
topics.reason: The noun is definite and genitive as the complement of the partitive preposition.

topics.headline: sociability and forgetting pressure remain local color
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the human collective as socially vulnerable to mass misguidance, while the local sense remains people.
topics.reason: The root-dispute pressure may color human vulnerability, but the local definite noun selects the collective people rather than an abstract act of sociability or forgetting.

topics.headline: collective people precede individual conditionals
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that public-human misguidance is named before the ayah sorts individual responses through following or disobedience.
topics.reason: The collective noun comes at the end of the complaint clause and before the two open person-conditionals.

topics.headline: people recur as a surah-wide public field
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the misled people of 14:36 belong to the same public field later addressed by warning and appeal in the surah.
topics.reason: The people noun recurs in public-field scenes including 14:34, 14:37, 14:44, and 14:52.

words.gloss_range: resultative connector that turns the idol-misguidance complaint into the first conditional response frame
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) changes the movement from diagnosis to disposition. Because the idols have misled many, the sentence immediately branches into the first open response case: whoever follows Ibrāhīm. The connector makes the conditional framework answer the complaint rather than merely continue narration.

topics.headline: connector launches first conditional
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the first conditional is grammatically dependent on the preceding idol complaint.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the following clause as the first conditional protasis.

topics.headline: misguidance report branches into classification
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Ibrāhīm answers the problem of mass misguidance by sorting responses, not by naming punishment immediately.
topics.reason: The connector follows the completed complaint clause and introduces the first branch of the response pair.

words.gloss_range: open person-conditional introducing the follower class by action rather than lineage or named identity
words.prose: {{ar:مَن}} ({{tr:man}}) makes the follower class open: whoever follows, not a named lineage or tribe. Conditional and relative force both point to the same payoff, because the person is defined by the act that follows. Its repetition later creates the ayah's two-part human sorting frame.

topics.headline: conditional whoever universalizes the follower
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belonging is opened to whoever follows, making action rather than prior identity the criterion.
topics.reason: The particle functions as the subject of the first conditional protasis and governs the following verb.

topics.headline: repeated person-conditionals form a binary
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that this first open class is designed to be paired with the later disobedient class.
topics.reason: The same conditional architecture recurs at word 14, creating the paired response frame.

words.gloss_range: following Ibrāhīm as direct personal alignment in an open conditional; Form I keeps a path-tracking sense rather than formal adoption alone
words.root_gloss_range: following, walking behind, tracking, conforming, succession, and adherence; the local Form I selects direct following of Ibrāhīm
words.prose: {{ar:تَبِعَنِى}} ({{tr:tabiʿanī}}) makes the criterion personal: the attached object directs following toward Ibrāhīm himself. The perfect form sits inside a conditional, so its force remains open to whoever follows or will follow. The root's tracking image and Form I profile make the affiliation feel like movement along Ibrāhīm's path, while 14:44 contrasts this genuine following with a later deferred promise to follow.

topics.headline: attached object makes following personal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Ibrāhīm himself is the grammatical axis of following before belonging is stated.
topics.reason: The verb carries a first-person object suffix, and attachment evidence treats that suffix as the direct object.

topics.headline: perfect in condition remains open
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the formally perfect verb does not close the class in the past; it remains open to anyone who follows.
topics.reason: The verb is perfect in the protasis of an open person-conditional.

topics.headline: Form I gives direct path-tracking alignment
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices following as direct path-tracking behind Ibrāhīm, while the local form does not require the more formal adoption profile of other forms.
topics.reason: The local form is Form I, so broader root and Form VIII contrasts provide pressure without replacing the selected direct-following sense.

topics.headline: following opposes disobedience and contrasts deferred following
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that following Ibrāhīm is the positive alternative to idol separation and to later failed promises of following.
topics.reason: The same first-person object axis returns in the disobedience verb, and the same root contrasts with deferred following in 14:44.

words.gloss_range: apodosis marker tying the follower's belonging directly to the condition of following
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) marks the answer to the first condition. It makes belonging the grammatical consequence of following, not a detached honorific statement. Because the same apodosis marker returns in the second conditional, the symmetry prepares the reader for outcomes that will diverge sharply.

topics.headline: result marker ties following to belonging
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that affiliation is grammatically triggered by following.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the apodosis answering the first conditional protasis.

topics.headline: matching apodosis markers set up divergence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the two conditional halves use the same machinery before their results split.
topics.reason: The first and second apodoses both begin with the same result marker followed by an assertion particle.

words.gloss_range: emphatic apodosis pronoun resuming the open follower as a single representative subject for the belonging claim
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّهُۥ}} ({{tr:innahu}}) turns the open whoever into a single representative he for the result clause. The assertion particle makes the follower's belonging certain rather than hoped-for. As the middle member of the ayah's three assertion-pronoun forms, it stands between the idol complaint and the final turn to God.

topics.headline: singular pronoun resumes the open follower
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that any follower is compressed into a representative subject for the status claim.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence identifies the pronoun as resuming the first conditional subject.

topics.headline: assertion makes follower status certain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belonging to Ibrāhīm is stated emphatically as the conditional result.
topics.reason: The assertion particle governs the apodosis, with the following prepositional phrase as predicate.

topics.headline: middle assertion in triple chain
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices an assertion chain moving from idols to follower to God.
topics.reason: The ayah repeats assertion-plus-pronoun forms at words 2, 11, and 17.

words.gloss_range: compact prepositional predicate of affiliation with Ibrāhīm, allowing belonging, source, likeness, and community pressure without specifying genealogy
words.prose: {{ar:مِنِّى}} ({{tr:minnī}}) states the follower's result as relation to Ibrāhīm in one compact prepositional predicate. Its range can include belonging, shared path, likeness, and community, but the local condition makes alignment the gateway rather than bloodline. That makes the phrase resonate with affiliation formulas such as the denied kinship in 11:46 without making genealogy the local point.

topics.headline: prepositional predicate states affiliation
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that belonging is expressed through a short relational predicate, not a separate communal label.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the prepositional phrase the predicate of the assertion clause.

topics.headline: belonging range exceeds bloodline
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that following creates belonging to Ibrāhīm without the phrase having to specify lineage, community, or likeness separately.
topics.reason: The local conditional supplies alignment as the criterion, so the preposition's broader affiliation range is preserved without turning into a bloodline claim.

topics.headline: affiliation formula resonates with denied kinship
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a Quranic affiliation contrast where belonging can be denied or granted by response rather than mere family status.
topics.reason: The row's echo to Nūḥ's son in 11:46 is useful as an affiliation contrast, but it does not control the local syntax.

words.gloss_range: coordinating connector that pairs the second conditional with the first while letting contrast emerge between following and disobedience
words.prose: {{ar:وَ}} ({{tr:wa}}) keeps the second conditional inside the same frame as the first. It coordinates rather than starts over, so disobedience appears as the paired counterpart to following on the same prophetic axis. The contrast is carried by the coordinated verbs and the outcomes that follow.

topics.headline: coordination preserves parallel syntax
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disobedience clause is paired with the follower clause rather than appended as a new topic.
topics.reason: The conjunction introduces the second conditional under the same person-condition and apodosis pattern.

topics.headline: coordination carries the response contrast
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that following and disobedience are opposed responses to the same prophetic direction.
topics.reason: The connector joins the two conditionals, and the contrasted verbs supply the response opposition.

words.gloss_range: second open person-conditional defining the disobedient class by response rather than named identity
words.prose: {{ar:مَنْ}} ({{tr:man}}) mirrors the earlier open whoever, so the disobedient are not a named historical group but anyone who satisfies the condition. The repeated particle makes the protases symmetrical, but that symmetry exists to expose an asymmetry: the follower is related to Ibrāhīm, while the disobeyer is handed upward to God's attributes.

topics.headline: second whoever universalizes disobedience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disobedient class is open and action-defined, just like the follower class.
topics.reason: The particle is the subject of the second conditional protasis.

topics.headline: parallel conditionals prepare asymmetric outcomes
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar treats both response classes with the same open frame before the outcomes diverge.
topics.reason: Both halves use person-conditionals, but the first resolves in affiliation and the second resolves in direct address to God.

words.gloss_range: disobeying Ibrāhīm as direct transitive refusal in the second conditional; the root's rigidity image colors resistance without replacing the local disobedience sense
words.root_gloss_range: disobedience, rebellion, resistance, and a related staff or rod image; the local verb selects refusing or disobeying a direct object
words.prose: {{ar:عَصَانِى}} ({{tr:ʿaṣānī}}) makes the negative response direct: the disobedience takes Ibrāhīm as its object, so it is not abstract lawlessness. The root's staff-like rigidity sharpens the feel of refusal as unbending resistance, while the local transitive verb still means disobeying him. Its matching first-person object and protective nūn mirror the following verb's morphology, making alignment and resistance pivot around the same prophetic person before the case is left to God's mercy.

topics.headline: explicit object makes disobedience personal
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that disobedience is directed against Ibrāhīm's prophetic direction, not left as generic rebellion.
topics.reason: Attachment evidence makes the first-person suffix the direct object, and the valency profile allows transitive use here.

topics.headline: staff image colors refusal as rigidity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices disobedience as stiff, unbending resistance, while the local verb remains a finite act of disobeying.
topics.reason: The root family includes disobedience and a staff image, but local grammar selects the transitive disobedience verb.

topics.headline: same object axis opposes following and disobedience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that following and disobeying are opposite responses to the same Ibrāhīm-centered axis.
topics.reason: Both response verbs carry the first-person object suffix, and the second mirrors the first morphologically while reversing its meaning.

topics.headline: disobedient case is deferred to divine mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Ibrāhīm names disobedience but does not close the outcome with condemnation; the case is moved into God's mercy clause.
topics.reason: The disobedience protasis is followed by an apodosis addressed to God and asserting mercy attributes.

words.gloss_range: second apodosis marker that redirects the expected result from the disobedient person to direct address about God's mercy
words.prose: {{ar:فَ}} ({{tr:fa}}) creates the result slot after disobedience, but the content refuses to name punishment. Instead the clause turns toward God and His attributes. Because the first apodosis spoke about the follower and this one speaks to God, the identical grammar makes the pronoun shift the ayah's pivot.

topics.headline: second apodosis redirects result to God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the grammar prepares a consequence for disobedience, then fills it with direct address to God's mercy rather than punishment.
topics.reason: The particle introduces the second apodosis, whose content is a statement about God rather than a named outcome for the disobedient.

topics.headline: punitive expectation is displaced
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the shock of a mercy formula occupying the consequence slot where retribution could have appeared.
topics.reason: The row's punitive expectation is a rhetorical contrast; local grammar confirms that the actual apodosis asserts forgiveness and mercy.

topics.headline: parallel apodosis marker creates the pivot
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that identical result grammar highlights the shift from a statement about the follower to an address to God.
topics.reason: The first and second result clauses share the same opening structure while their pronouns and addressees diverge.

words.gloss_range: emphatic direct-address particle with second-person suffix, making God the asserted subject of the final mercy predicate field
words.prose: {{ar:إِنَّكَ}} ({{tr:innaka}}) moves the final result from the disobedient person to direct address of God. The assertion particle makes forgiveness and mercy the relevant divine predicate field after disobedience. As the last member of the ayah's pronoun sequence, it lifts the movement from idols, to follower, to God.

topics.headline: direct address makes God the final subject
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the disobedient person's outcome is redirected into an emphatic statement of God's own attributes.
topics.reason: The second-person suffix is the subject of the assertion particle, and the following two attributes are the predicate field.

topics.headline: suffix shift completes the pronoun sequence
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the pronoun movement from idols to follower to God as a structural ascent.
topics.reason: The ayah repeats assertion-plus-pronoun forms with changing suffixes: feminine plural, masculine singular, then second person.

topics.headline: Ibrāhīm-centered belonging yields to divine mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that Ibrāhīm claims the follower but hands judgment over disobedience upward to God.
topics.reason: The first apodosis centers relation to Ibrāhīm, while the second centers direct address to God and His attributes.

words.gloss_range: first nominative intensive predicate asserting God's capacious forgiving quality after the disobedience condition
words.root_gloss_range: covering, concealing, protecting, forgiveness, seeking forgiveness, and repeated forgiving; the local faʿūl adjective selects divine forgiving capacity
words.prose: {{ar:غَفُورٌۭ}} ({{tr:ghafūrun}}) stands as the first asserted predicate after the disobedience clause. Its root gives forgiveness the feel of protective covering rather than bare deletion, and the faʿūl pattern presents a stable capacity for repeated forgiving. The familiar mercy pairing appears here in a marked position after disobedience without an intervening repentance clause, while 14:41 later turns the same root into an explicit forgiveness petition.

topics.headline: first predicate asserts forgiveness of God
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that forgiveness is not a subordinate adjective; it is the first asserted divine predicate after disobedience.
topics.reason: QAC identifies the word as a nominative predicate of the assertion clause.

topics.headline: covering root shapes forgiveness
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices forgiveness as protective covering of fault, while the local adjective remains the divine forgiving attribute.
topics.reason: The root range supports covering and forgiveness, but the local selected form is the intensive divine adjective rather than a request or verbal act.

topics.headline: faʿūl form marks habitual forgiving capacity
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices a stable and capacious forgiving capacity, while the form is distinct from other intensive patterns in the same root family.
topics.reason: The local word is an intensive adjective on the faʿūl pattern, not the separate faʿʿāl form.

topics.headline: forgiveness formula appears after disobedience
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the familiar forgiveness-mercy formula in a surprising slot after disobedience and before the later explicit petition.
topics.reason: The attribute pair follows the disobedience protasis here, and the same root appears again in the explicit forgiveness petition at 14:41.

words.gloss_range: second nominative intensive mercy attribute sealing the ayah's final predicate field with compassion paired to forgiveness
words.root_gloss_range: mercy, compassion, womb-related protective care, and divine mercy attributes; the local faʿīl adjective selects ingrained mercifulness
words.prose: {{ar:رَّحِيمٌۭ}} ({{tr:raḥīmun}}) seals the final clause by fusing mercy with forgiveness as God's asserted nature. Its nominative indefiniteness lets it stand as a second predicate or attach closely to the prior predicate, so the two attributes remain grammatically bound. The root's womb-related mercy image gives the closing word protective compassion, and the selected adjectival form keeps it paired with forgiveness rather than shifting to the separate expansive name pattern. After disobedience without an intervening repentance clause, the prayer closes by asserting what God is rather than asking for a specific act, and the final nasal cadence makes the mercy formula the ayah's last sound after the turbulent conditionals.

topics.headline: mercy stands as second predicate or close modifier
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that mercy is grammatically attached to God's asserted nature at the close, not added loosely.
topics.reason: QAC and attachment evidence identify the word as a nominative second predicate, while agreement also permits close adjectival attachment to the prior predicate.

topics.headline: root and faʿīl form make mercy ingrained
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices mercy as deep protective compassion and ingrained quality, while the local word remains the paired adjectival attribute.
topics.reason: The root and faʿīl pattern support inner mercy pressure, while the local form is the adjective paired with the forgiveness predicate.

topics.headline: adjectival mercy differs from expansive name form
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the close selects paired adjectival mercy, not a shift into the separate expansive name pattern.
topics.reason: The local pattern is faʿīl and functions with the preceding predicate; other mercy forms remain contrastive evidence.

topics.headline: attribute pair answers disobedience with mercy
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that rebellion is met by a paired field of covering and compassion rather than by a direct punishment formula.
topics.reason: The attribute pair follows the disobedience protasis and supplies the response field for that case.

topics.headline: mercy formula closes the prayer with divine nature
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices the asymmetry between Ibrāhīm's belonging claim for followers and God's nature as the final answer for disobedience.
topics.reason: The first conditional closes with affiliation to Ibrāhīm, while the second closes with God's attributes and no explicit punishment statement.

topics.headline: nasal cadence seals the mercy formula
topics.reader_payoff: The reader notices that the final sound and syntax seal the ayah on mercy after the conditional turbulence.
topics.reason: The closing predicate pair carries repeated nominative tanwīn and ends the ayah on the mercy attribute, while the second apodosis supplies the reversal structure.

branches.scope_ar: يدخل فيه الرقة والعطف والرأفة والإحسان إلى المرحوم والمرحمة والتراحم والترحم وأسماء الرحمن والرحيم من جهة الاشتقاق من الرحمة.
branches.scope_en: Includes tenderness, compassion, pity, beneficence toward the one shown mercy, mutual mercy, invoking mercy, and the names al-Rahman and al-Rahim as derived from mercy.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبِّ إِنَّهُنَّ أَضْلَلْنَ كَثِيرًا مِّنَ النَّاسِ
baseline_models.mechanism: The causative أَضْلَلْنَ presents the feminine plural objects as agents of departure and loss, while رَبِّ invokes the counter-role of one who tends, repairs, and completes. كَثِيرًا scales the danger into population movement.

activation_trace.role: Repair, upbringing, and completion make the address a caretaker appeal over people made lost.
Departure from guidance and intended direction supplies the core routing failure.
Loss of a thing from its possessor sharpens straying into relational displacement.
Numerical growth makes the misdirection socially reproductive rather than isolated.

changed_reading.before: The idols caused many individuals to hold a false belief.
changed_reading.after: Ibrahim reports a large-scale loss of direction and asks the repairing caretaker to deal with a population displaced from its proper course.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: فَمَن تَبِعَنِي فَإِنَّهُ مِنِّي وَمَنْ عَصَانِي فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
baseline_models.mechanism: Following is directional alignment behind Ibrahim, but مِنِّي converts alignment into belonging. The opposed clause names disobedience without supplying the expected inverse exclusion; it transfers that person to divine covering and mercy. The mercy root's kinship branch keeps familial belonging live beside allegiance.

activation_trace.role: Trailing and taking another's course supply the enacted alignment preceding مِنِّي.
Departure from obedience supplies the contrast without itself stating expulsion.
Covering the offense and protecting its bearer supplies the response to disobedience.
Kinship and relational bonds echo the belonging asserted by مِنِّي.

changed_reading.before: The obedient belong to Ibrahim, whereas the disobedient might be pardoned.
changed_reading.after: Following constitutes a person as 'of' Ibrahim, while disobedience is not answered with explicit severance but left inside God's covering mercy.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah turns the focus causative into route architecture. A straight path is opposed by obstruction and crookedness; later blessing is exchanged, rivals are deliberately made, and misdirection is aimed away from a path. Idols work as installed rival waypoints, not unexplained autonomous objects.

activation_trace.role: A straight traversable path supplies the destination-relative geometry presupposed by straying.
Turning away and turning others aside supplies active blockage in the route.
Deviation of meaning from straightness makes distortion a means of rerouting.
One thing standing in another's place supplies the substitution preceding communal ruin.
A counterpart set in opposition supplies the rival waypoint competing for allegiance.
The causative purpose explicitly connects installed rivals with departure from direction.
An extended way to be traveled identifies what the rivals divert people away from.

structural_cues: 14:1 and 14:3 establish path, obstruction, and crookedness before 14:28-30 narrate substitution and made rivals.
The purpose construction in 14:30 directly joins rival-making to departure from the path.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies path geometry, substitution, made rivals, and misdirection; I infer the arrow from installing an alternative allegiance to rerouting people through it. A live alternative is that these are parallel descriptions rather than one routing mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Idols independently exert a mysterious misleading power.
changed_reading.after: They mislead as installed rival waypoints: substitution changes the route of allegiance and carries people away from the path.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same movement is assigned at different levels to God, rival-makers, leaders, callers, and responders. Failed follower-leader dependency is followed by Satan denying coercive power and reducing his role to a call that people answered. Focus attribution can name effective social cause without granting idols independent coercion.

activation_trace.role: Divine causation of departure supplies a layer above the focus ayah's object-level attribution.
The weak trailing the arrogant supplies a concrete chain of misdirected followership.
Coercive force is explicitly denied, bounding how a misleading agent operates.
A verbal call that inclines another supplies the initiating social signal.
Answering speech supplies the followers' uptake that completes the causal circuit.
Blame redirected to respondents preserves their agency within the misleading relation.

structural_cues: 14:4 and 14:27 make God the subject of causative ض ل ل, while 14:30 gives rival-makers a misleading purpose.
14:21-22 moves from failed leader dependence to a caller who denies coercion and identifies follower response.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies multiple agents, absent coercion, invitation, uptake, and blame; I infer nested causation in which made objects concentrate loyalties people ratify. A live alternative is direct rhetorical attribution without specified mediation.

changed_reading.before: The feminine plural subject is the sole efficient cause of straying.
changed_reading.after: Its causality is layered and participatory: installed rivals, leaders, invitation, uptake, answerability, and divine judgment converge.

context_deltas.mechanism: Calling, answering, delay, and fixed term make followership temporal. The divine call opens forgiveness during a deferred term; later wrongdoers ask for delay so they can answer and follow. Focus following is a trajectory enacted while response remains possible, not a retrospective label.

activation_trace.role: The call that inclines hearers supplies the opening to guiding response.
Forgiveness tied to the call supplies repair within the response interval.
Postponement supplies a bounded interval rather than endless deferral.
A prescribed temporal limit closes the response interval.
Nearness in time makes the requested extension explicitly short.
Answering names the action omitted until warning arrived.
Following messengers is paired with answering, making it enacted response.

structural_cues: 14:10 orders call, forgiveness, postponement, and fixed term; 14:44 reverses this into a late request to answer and follow.
The focus assigns belonging after the act of following.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated call-response language and a closing window; I infer that 'follows me' is response embodied before the deadline. A live alternative is that 14:44 depicts repentance generally without defining 14:36.

changed_reading.before: Following Ibrahim is a static identity or profession.
changed_reading.after: Following is a time-sensitive trajectory: one becomes 'of me' by answering and taking the messenger's course while response can become lived practice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The word-tree sequence supplies an organic account of becoming مِنِّي: a communicative word has rooted origin, stable branch, and recurring yield; its opposite is pulled out whole and lacks settlement. A follower can be read as propagated practice rather than merely a party member.

activation_trace.role: Meaningful speech connecting speakers supplies the transmissible source.
Rootedness and established origin supply continuity with the source.
Durability prevents propagated belonging from being momentary attachment.
A branch emerging from an origin supplies the material analogy for becoming 'from me.'
Recurring yield supplies an observable consequence of genuine propagation.
Extraction from the root supplies the contrary of source-continuity.
Denied stability and settlement expose what unrooted affiliation lacks.
Misdirection opposed to stabilization links the tree contrast to the focus danger.

structural_cues: 14:24-26 sustains word, root, branch, yield, uprooting, and lack of settlement.
14:27 restates the contrast as stabilization versus causative straying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a word propagated as a rooted tree; I map مِنِّي onto branch-from-source and following onto transmitted practice. A live alternative is that the tree concerns good speech generally without specifying Ibrahim's lineage.

changed_reading.after: To follow Ibrahim is to become stable, fruit-bearing propagation from his word and practice; 'of me' is enacted continuity, not genealogy alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequence creates opposed fields of attraction. Ibrahim asks separation from worshipped bodies, reports their displacement of many people, then asks human hearts to incline toward his descendants at the protected House. Following becomes affective-spatial reorientation toward a prayer-bearing household.

activation_trace.role: Keeping apart supplies requested separation from idol worship.
A worshipped body identifies the immediate feminine plural danger.
Caused departure supplies the first attraction field's displacement.
A dwelling and shelter supplies the alternative spatial center.
The inwardly kindled heart makes the counter-movement affective.
The same human collective affected by idols supplies hearts for the counter-movement.
Inclination of the self supplies positive attraction toward the household.

structural_cues: 14:35-37 consecutively gives separation, mass misdirection, and requested inclination of people's hearts.
Both 14:36 and 14:37 use النَّاس for the human field under opposed pressures.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies sequence, separation, displacement, a house, hearts, and inclination; I infer that the third petition establishes a counter-attractor. A live alternative is that the adjacent petitions are functionally independent.

changed_reading.before: A follower makes a primarily intellectual decision to obey.
changed_reading.after: Following is also affective-spatial reorientation: hearts incline toward Ibrahim's prayer-bearing household against idol displacement.

context_deltas.mechanism: The prayer names descendants, gifted sons, parents, and believers, while the focus places a follower inside Ibrahim's مِنِّي and leaves a disobedient person to divine mercy. Biological lineage remains present, but allegiance admits people and prayer widens beyond descent.

activation_trace.role: Enacted adherence is the focus threshold for becoming مِنِّي.
Kinship bonds keep lineage semantics active in the appeal.
Smallness and dispersal supply an image for descendants propagated into a new place.
Children received as gift prevent descent from appearing self-produced.
The request to cover sins carries the focus ending into widened beneficiaries.
Parents defined through birth supply unmistakable genealogy.
Believers supply a non-genealogical community included beside self and parents.

structural_cues: 14:37-41 moves through descendants, gifted sons, descendants again, then self, parents, and believers.
14:36 formulates positive relation through following rather than birth and does not explicitly expel the disobedient.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies genealogy, allegiance, and widening prayer objects; I infer an expandable lineage whose enacted criterion is following. A live alternative is that مِنِّي means party allegiance without genealogical coloring.

changed_reading.before: 'Of me' marks literal descent or a closed faction.
changed_reading.after: Ibrahim's 'me' is porous lineage: descent is named, but following admits people into enacted kinship and mercy reaches a wider relation.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This transfers agricultural and womb images into a moral petition. It remains anchored because the focus begins with رَبِّ and ends with غَفُورٌ رَحِيمٌ, whose branches supply repair, covering, and life-bearing enclosure, while nearby context gives fruit in a barren setting. Render only as exploratory material analogy, not lexical replacement, and retain the uprooted-tree tension.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: رَبِّ ... وَمَنْ عَصَانِي فَإِنَّكَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ

activation_trace.role: Repair and gradual completion supply the caretaker side of the analogy.
A protective cover supplies preservation rather than bare cancellation.
The womb as life-bearing enclosure supplies the bold restorative image.
Absence of cultivation supplies the difficult environment.
Requested ripe fruit supplies restoration across barrenness.

changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the disobedient is entrusted to a cultivator who can cover, shelter, and restore conditions for life and fruit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because the focus uses the ordinary verb 'follow,' while liability is another branch of the root. It remains live because مِنِّي accepts the follower into Ibrahim's relation and 14:21 stages followers asking leaders for relief. Render as ethical root resonance, never direct translation.

activation_trace.role: A consequence or claim adhering to a person supplies the responsibility resonance.
Followers attached to arrogant leaders supply the failed comparison.
The question whether leaders can avail them supplies an unmet protective expectation.

changed_reading.before: 'Of me' marks identity and affinity only.
changed_reading.after: As contained root resonance, Ibrahim may also accept answerability for followers unlike leaders unable to protect dependents.

strongest_changes: Idol causation became installed route architecture and distributed invitation-response rather than autonomous object agency.
مِنِّي became enacted, fruit-bearing, and porous lineage rather than blood descent or party identity alone.
Following became timely response, with late wished-for following distinguished from a lived prior course.
The 14:35-37 sequence set idol displacement against hearts inclining toward a prayer-bearing household.
summary.what_was_special: Whole-surah recurrences unfolded route, agency, call-response, lineage, and cultivation mechanisms while preserving the focus asymmetry: following creates belonging, but disobedience is entrusted to God rather than explicitly answered with expulsion.
remaining_uncertainties: The relation between divine causation, human installation, invitation, and uptake remains unresolved.
The tree-to-lineage mapping is abductive and can concern belief or speech generally.
The counter-attraction reading depends on treating 14:35-37 as one functional sequence.
The cultivation and liability outliers are branch-distant and not direct lexical glosses.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Idols misdirect through scale, while following builds affiliation.** `ض ل ل` `B001` (straying from an aim), `ك ث ر` `B002` (outnumbering/rivalry in abundance), `ت ب ع` `B003` (stepwise tracking), and `ن ف س` is absent but the fixed *minni* construction makes proximity relational. Earlier manufactured rivals were designed to divert paths; here their success is measured in many people. I infer repeated following turns orientation into belonging. “From me” reads as path-generated affiliation rather than blood identity alone.

2. **Disobedience remains inside a protective field rather than being made Abraham's possession.** `ع ص ي` `B001` gives leaving obedience; `غ ف ر` `B001` protective covering and `B002` shielding from consequence coexist with `ر ح م` `B001` mercy. The grammatical shift from “follows me” to direct address “You are forgiving, merciful” transfers the disobedient away from Abrahamic control. I infer Abraham refuses to close the outcome himself. The prayer preserves accountability and possible protection without merging them.
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: Ayah 14:41's movement from parents to all believers confirmed that “from me” is expandable affiliation: faithful relation can extend kin-like care beyond descent.

reader_a.activated_readings_md:
1. **Misguidance operates through competing inclination.** `ض ل ل B001` supplies departure from guidance, while 14:37's `ه و ي B004` supplies desire and inclination when hearts are asked to incline toward the settled family. The fixed idols pull many away; the next ayah requests a counter-attraction toward worship, people, and provision. The packet supplies opposed directions of attraction; I infer desire as the transmission mechanism. `أَضْلَلْنَ` reads as redirected attachment, not false information alone.
2. **Following creates relational belonging; disobedience does not close every bond.** `ت ب ع B001` supplies following and `ع ص ي B001` leaving obedience. The first conditional explicitly converts following into `مِنِّى`; the second does not pronounce exclusion but turns to `غ ف ر B002` forgiveness and `ر ح م B001` mercy. I infer that enacted following establishes belonging, while disobedience is placed under a still-open divine repair relation. The two conditions should remain asymmetrical rather than being forced into equal verdicts.
3. **Mercy acquires a kinship-repair scope.** `ر ح م B002` supplies kinship bond, activated by the dense sequence of sons, descendants, gifted children, parents, and believers in 14:35-41. The fixed `رَحِيم` occurs precisely after “from me” and disobedience. I infer that mercy can preserve or repair relation when obedience has failed. The adjective reads not only as tenderness (`ر ح م B001`) but as divine custody of a threatened bond.
4. **Exploratorily, people are socially swayable.** The packet roots `ٱلنَّاس` in `ن و س`, whose `B001` supplies swaying or oscillation. The many are moved away here, while hearts move toward the family in 14:37. I infer a population-level susceptibility to competing pulls. This is a root-image activation, not a claim that the ordinary surface meaning “people” should be replaced by “swaying.”
reader_a.retrospective_surprises_md: 14:37 supplied a counter-pull when hearts were asked to incline and move, making misguidance a competition of attractions and activating the exploratory sway of `ن و س B001`. By 14:41, the widening prayer to parents and believers confirmed mercy's kinship-repair scope.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi, yönetim ve düzenleme çekirdeğini destekler. Bununla birlikte yalın ve mutlak kullanım Tanrı'ya özgüdür; insanlar ve nesneler için anlam, sahip olunan ya da yönetilen şeyin belirtilmesine bağlıdır.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Tanrı'ya özgü mutlak kullanım ile bir şeyin sahibi ya da yöneticisi olmayı bildiren tamlamalı kullanım ayrı tutulmalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Yalın biçim ile ev, hayvan veya başka bir şey üzerinden kurulan tamlamalar aynı kapsamda değildir; tanım bu kullanım koşulunu korur.

concept_map.definition: Bir varlık ya da şey üzerinde sahiplik, üstün yetke ve düzenleyici yönetim kurma niteliğidir. Mutlak kullanım Tanrı'yı gösterirken başka kullanımlar yönetilen veya sahip olunan şeyi açıkça belirtir.

facets.statement: Sahiplik, buyruk yetkisi ve yönetip düzenleme aynı çekirdekte birleşir.

branches.source_phrase_ar: الرب: الله تبارك وتعالى؛ ورب كل شيء مالكه (jamhara); رب كل شئ: مالكه؛ وقد قالوه في الجاهلية للملك؛ رببت القوم: سستهم (sihah); يكون الرب: المالك؛ ويكون الرب: السيد المطاع؛ ويكون الرب: المصلح (tahdhib); الرب مصدر مستعار للفاعل؛ لا يقال الرب مطلقا إلا لله؛ رب الدار ورب الفرس (mufradat); فالرب المالك والخالق والصاحب؛ والله جل ثناؤه الرب (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, bir şeyi gözeterek düzeltme, geliştirme ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış duruma getirme sürecini tutarlı biçimde gösterir. Çocuk yetiştirme, mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama bu sürecin farklı nesneleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Anlam yalnız bakım göstermeyi değil, gözetilen şeyi zaman içinde düzeltip tamamlamayı gerektirir.

lexicalization_scope.note: Eylemin yalın gelişim çekirdeği ile çocuk, mülk ve yapılan iyilik gibi nesnelere bağlı kullanımları ayrıştırılarak korunur.

concept_map.definition: Bir şeyi sürekli gözetim altında düzeltmek, geliştirmek ve aşama aşama tamamlanmış durumuna ulaştırmaktır.

facets.statement: Süreç, gözetilen şeyi eksik durumdan tamamlanmış duruma doğru geliştirir.
Çocuk yetiştirme, bir mülkü iyileştirme ve yapılan iyiliği tamamlama başlıca uygulamalardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar düzeltme, sürekli bakım, yetiştirme ve tamamlama öğelerini tek bir aşamalı gelişim sürecinde birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Bakımın gelişme, düzeltme ve tamamlanma sonucuna yöneldiği bütün genel bağlamlarda kullanılabilir.

error_profile.preserves: Aşamalı gelişim, bakım, düzeltme ve tamamlanma öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Bir çocuğun veya canlı varlığın gelişimini üstlenme bağlamında doğal karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Sürekli bakım yoluyla gelişip olgunlaştırma sürecini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Mülk, iş veya yapılan iyilik gibi bir nesneyi eksiksiz duruma getirme bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Düzeltme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucunu korur.
Gözetim ve ilgilenme yönünü kısmen korur.
error_profile.loses: Düzeltme, aşamalı geliştirme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucunu kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Gözetilen şeyi aşama aşama geliştirme ve tamamlanmış duruma ulaştırma sonucu odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Aralıklı yoklama, öğüt verme ve çevresel bakım gibi tamamlanma gerektirmeyen kullanımlar komşuda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da bir şeyin bakımını üstlenme, onu düzeltme ve iyi durumda tutma alanında örtüşür.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal gelişim sürecini tamamlanma sınırına taşır; komşu dal ise bakımın yinelenmesini ve gözetimi sonuçtan bağımsız olarak kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bakım ile tamamlama arasındaki en ince sınırı gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız büyüme, akrabalık veya olgunluk alanını paylaşanlar dışarıda bırakıldı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه رب الشيء إذا أصلحه وأتمه وقام عليه، ورب النعمة والصنيعة والضيعة والولد والصبي، والتربية حالا فحالا
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليست السيادة المجردة بلا معنى الإصلاح، ولا القرابة الربيبة نفسها
branches.source_phrase_ar: رب الرجل النعمة يربها ربا؛ ربابة أيضا إذا تممها (jamhara); رب الضيعة أي أصلحها وأتمها؛ رب فلان ولده؛ رباه (sihah); رب الشيء أي أصلحه؛ رب فلان الصنيعة إذا أتمها وأصلحها (tahdhib); التربية، وهو إنشاء الشيء حالا فحالا إلى حد التمام؛ ربه ورباه ورببه (mufradat); رب فلان ضيعته إذا قام على إصلاحها؛ رببت الصبي أربه (maqayis); ربته تربيتا إذا رببه (maqayis-rbt)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, Tanrı bilgisiyle donanmış, dinî hükümleri bilen, bilgeliği olan ve başkalarını temel bilgilerden başlayarak yetiştiren bilgin tipini ortak bir kimlikte birleştirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Bu dal sıradan bilgi sahipliğini değil, Tanrı bilgisi, dinî uzmanlık ve öğretici yetiştirme görevini birlikte taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan bilgin ve öğretici kişi anlamıyla sınırlıdır; başka yapılardan anlam aktarılmaz.

concept_map.definition: Tanrı bilgisine ve dinî hükümlere hâkim, bilgece davranan ve insanları temel bilgiden ileri bilgiye doğru yetiştiren bilgindir.

facets.statement: Kişi Tanrı bilgisiyle ve dinî konulardaki sağlam bilgisiyle tanımlanır.
Bilgiyi yalnız taşımakla kalmaz, başkalarını küçük adımlarla öğretip yetiştirir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar Tanrı'yı bilme, dinî hükümleri kavrama, bilgelik ve aşamalı öğreticilik özelliklerini aynı bilgin kişide bir araya getirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Dinî bilgi, bilgelik ve öğretici yetiştiricilik özelliklerinin birlikte vurgulandığı kişi için uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Tanrı bilgisi, bilginlik ve aşamalı öğreticilik öğelerini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Kişinin dinî uzmanlığı ile insan yetiştirme görevini birlikte anlatan bağlamlarda kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Dinî uzmanlık ve öğretici yetiştirme görevini birlikte korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: Tanrı bilgisine sahip bilgin ve öğretici

error_profile.preserves: Bilgi sahibi olma yönünü genel olarak korur.
error_profile.loses: Tanrı bilgisi, dinî sınır ve insanları aşama aşama yetiştirme görevini kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Tanrı bilgisi ve insanları temel bilgilerden başlayarak yetiştirme görevi odak dalda belirleyicidir.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Dinî hukuk hükümlerinde uzmanlaşma komşu dalın daha dar mesleki sınırıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da dinî hükümleri bilen ve bu alanda yetkin sayılan bilgini gösterebilir.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal dinî bilgiyi Tanrı bilgisi, bilgelik ve öğreticilikle genişletir; komşu dal ise özellikle dinî hukuk bilgisinde uzmanlaşır.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; dinî uzmanlık ile öğretici bilgin kimliği arasındaki sınırı en açık gösteren aday seçildi, yalnız bilgelik veya saygınlık bildiren adaylar elendi.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الرباني والربانيون بمعنى العلماء والحكماء وأهل العلم بالرب أو من يرب العلم ونفسه به
branches.what_is_not_ar: ليس الربيون إذا أريد بهم الألوف والجماعات، ولا ربان الملاحين
branches.source_phrase_ar: الرباني: المتأله العارف بالله تعالى (sihah); الرباني: العالم؛ العلماء بالحلال والحرام؛ حكماء علماء؛ العالم المعلم الذي يغذو الناس بصغار العلوم (tahdhib); الرباني... يرب العلم؛ يرب نفسه بالعلم؛ منسوب إلى الرب (mufradat); الربي العارف بالرب (maqayis)

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, çok sayıdaki insanın bir topluluk oluşturması ve ayrı kabilelerin tek bir birlik hâlinde toplanması çekirdeğini destekler. Sayı değeri ve belirli kabile birliği bu çekirdeğin özel gerçekleşmeleridir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: İnsan topluluğu anlamı, yalnız herhangi bir çoğulluğu değil büyük sayı veya fiilî birleşme niteliğini taşır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan tanıklanan büyük insan topluluğu ve birleşmiş kabileler alanında kalır; hayvan sürüsü anlamı bu dala genellenmez.

concept_map.definition: Çok sayıda insanın bir araya gelmesiyle oluşan büyük topluluk ya da ayrı kabilelerin ortak bir birlik hâlinde birleşmesidir.

facets.statement: Temel anlam, insanların büyük sayıda bir araya gelerek topluluk oluşturmasıdır.
On bin kişilik topluluk ve beş kabilenin tek birlik olması tanıklanan özel örneklerdir.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar binlerce kişilik toplulukları, on bin kişilik bir sayıyı ve birleşmiş kabileleri büyük sayı ile toplanma ortaklığında birleştirir.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çok sayıda insanın ya da birleşmiş kabilelerin oluşturduğu topluluğu genel olarak anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: İnsanlardan oluşma, büyüklük ve bir araya gelme çekirdeğini korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Ayrı kabilelerin tek bir ortak birlik oluşturduğu tarihsel topluluk bağlamında uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Kabilelerin toplanıp tek birlik oluşturması yönünü korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: büyük topluluk; on bin kişilik topluluk
tek birlik hâlinde birleşmiş beş kabile
insanları toplayan kişi veya toplanma yeri

error_profile.preserves: İnsan sayısının çokluğu yönünü korur.
error_profile.loses: Birleşmiş kabileler ile düzenli topluluk oluşturma ilişkisini kaybeder.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Çok büyük sayı ve ayrı kabilelerin tek birlik oluşturması odak dalın belirgin sınırıdır.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Karışık unsurlar, ordu ve genel toplama sonucu oluşan birlikler komşu dalda daha geniş yer tutar.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da insanların bir araya gelmesiyle oluşan topluluğu anlatır.
neighbor_distinctions.distinction: Odak dal büyük sayı ile kabile birliğini öne çıkarır; komşu dal ise sayı veya kabile koşulu olmadan her türlü toplanmış grubu kapsar.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; genel topluluk ile büyük ve birleşmiş topluluk arasındaki sınırı en iyi gösteren aday seçildi, öteki yakın grup adları tekrara düşmemek için alınmadı.
branches.what_is_ar: يدخل فيه الربة والجماعات الكثيرة، والربيون إذا فسروا بالألوف أو الجماعات، ورباب القبائل لاجتماعهم

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasındaki karşılıklı aile bağını destekler. Aynı dişil biçimin bakıcı kadın ve evde süt için beslenen hayvan anlamları da bulunduğundan bağlam ayrımı zorunludur.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Üvey çocuk, üvey ebeveyn ve bakıcı anlamları karşılıklı bakım ilişkisine bağlıdır; genel yetiştirme anlamıyla karıştırılmamalıdır.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım yalnız tanıklanan aile ve bakım rolleriyle sınırlıdır; genel bakım veya yetiştirme eylemi bu kişi adlarına taşınmaz.

concept_map.definition: Önceki bir eşten olan çocuk ile o çocuğun bakımını üstlenen yeni eş arasında kurulan üvey aile ve yetiştirme ilişkisidir. Bazı kullanımlarda bakıcı kadın ya da evde beslenen dişi hayvan da aynı bakım bağıyla adlandırılır.

facets.statement: Çocuk ve yeni eş, biyolojik olmayan fakat bakım üstlenilen aile ilişkisiyle birbirine bağlanır.
Bakıcı kadın ve evde sütü için beslenen dişi hayvan, bakım ilişkisine dayanan genişlemiş kullanımlardır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar üvey oğul ve kız ile annenin eşi veya babanın eşini karşılıklı bakım ilişkisi içinde açıklar; bakıcı kadın anlamını da bu çerçeveye ekler.

concept_gloss.applicability: Çocuk ile biyolojik olmayan bakımı üstlenen eş arasındaki karşılıklı aile ilişkisini anlatır.

error_profile.preserves: Üvey aile rolü ile bakım üstlenme ilişkisini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Eşin önceki birlikteliğinden olan oğul veya kız çocuğu için kullanılır.

error_profile.preserves: Çocuğun yeni eşle kurduğu biyolojik olmayan aile bağını korur.

error_profile.preserves: Yeni eşin çocuk üzerindeki aile ve bakım rolünü korur.

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Üvey çocuk ile annenin veya babanın yeni eşi arasındaki karşılıklı akrabalık rolleri odak dala özgüdür.

branches.neighbor_coverage_note: Bütün adaylar değerlendirildi; bakım üstlenme ile üvey aile rolü arasındaki sınırı açıklayan aday seçildi, yalnız çocuk, hane veya genel koruma alanını paylaşanlar yayımlanmadı.

identity_judgment.rationale: Kanıt, koyulaşmış meyve özü veya yağ tortusu olan bir maddeyi ve bu maddeyle deri kap, yiyecek ya da ilacın işlenip güçlendirilmesini tutarlı biçimde bir araya getirir.
identity_judgment.boundary_note: Maddenin kendisi ile o madde kullanılarak işlenmiş nesne ayrıdır; sahiplik ve yönetim anlamları bu dala girmez.

lexicalization_scope.note: Tanım doğrudan koyu öz veya tortu ile onun kullanıldığı işleme alanında kalır; benzer sesli sahiplik anlamına genişlemez.

concept_map.definition: Meyveden koyulaştırılmış öz ya da yağın koyu tortusudur; ayrıca deri kap, yiyecek veya ilaç bu madde sürülerek ya da katılarak işlenip güçlendirilir.

facets.statement: Temel madde koyu bir meyve özü veya yağın dibinde kalan koyu tortudur.
Deri, kap, yiyecek ve ilaç bu maddeyle işlenir, sağlamlaştırılır veya hazırlanır.

source_synthesis.common_summary: Tanıklıklar koyu öz ve yağ tortusu anlamını, deri kapların güçlendirilmesi ile yiyecek ve ilaçların bu maddeyle hazırlanması kullanımına bağlar.

concept_gloss.applicability: Maddenin kendisini ve ondan hareketle yapılan işleme uygulamalarını kapsayan genel karşılıktır.

error_profile.preserves: Koyulaşmış öz ile yağ tortusu seçeneklerini birlikte korur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Üzüm veya başka meyvelerden koyulaştırılmış özün söz konusu olduğu yiyecek bağlamında uygundur.

contextual_glosses.applicability: Deri kap, yiyecek veya ilacın koyu öz kullanılarak hazırlandığı bağlamda uygundur.

error_profile.preserves: Maddeyle işleme ve sağlamlaştırma ilişkisini korur.

lexical_glosses.target_gloss: koyu meyve özü veya yağ tortusu

neighbor_distinctions.focus_only: Meyve özü veya yağ tortusuyla deri, kap, yiyecek ve ilacı işleyip güçlendirme odak dala özgüdür.
neighbor_distinctions.neighbor_only: Erimiş metal, irin, katran suyu ve ekmek döküntüsü gibi çok çeşitli maddeler komşu dalda bulunur.
neighbor_distinctions.shared_zone: Her iki dal da yağın koyu tortusu veya yoğun bir çökeltiyi adlandırabilir.
